I rewrote and reorganized all the documentation and pushed it to the branch `docs/32-documentation-cleanup`. I couldn't open the pull request: GitHub blocks Actions from creating PRs in this repository. You can open it here: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/new/docs/32-documentation-cleanup. A full PR description is at `/tmp/pr.md`, but that file is lost when the runner shuts down. The main points are below.

`npm run check` passes: 315 tests (13 of them new), lint, unused-code and duplication checks, and coverage. All changes are in one commit, so every commit passes the checks.

## New structure
The README is now a short landing page: what pi-action does, a quick start, and a table of links to the docs. The details are in eight pages under `docs/`: `inputs`, `workflows`, `models`, `extensions`, `prompts`, `threads`, `security` and `how-it-works`. Each fact is written in one place and other pages link to it. Two sections that said the same thing ("Durable threads" and "Reading a thread") are now one. `examples/prompt-templates.md` is merged into `docs/prompts.md`, and the old file is now a one-line pointer so existing links still work. Each page puts its main point first and uses short, active, imperative sentences.

## Docs that were wrong
The code is unchanged; I only corrected the docs.
- **The README's pit example didn't work.** The line `github:cv/pit#v0.35.0   # pit's typescript tool` makes the run fail with "is not an npm package spec or a path". Only lines that *start* with `#` count as comments. I ran it to confirm.
- **"Input is sanitized" claimed too much.** HTML comments and invisible characters are removed only from the comment that mentions `@pi`, `/answer` replies and question titles. The issue or PR title and body, the diff and review comments reach the model as they are.
- **`prompt_template` does more than the docs said.** It replaces the whole first message, including the built-in "commit and push your work" instructions. It applies only to the first message of a new thread. There is also a
